note: Curriculum spine (pre-A1 to Goethe-Zertifikat B1, Basel, July 2027). grammar order follows the common DaF progression (Menschen, Netzwerk neu tables of contents via secondary sources) and the Goethe exam descriptions. can_do lines are short paraphrases of Goethe and fide descriptions, not verbatim quotes. scenarios are fide-style Basel situations. word_range is cumulative over the word files below, counted by the month field (an editorial assignment). The word list is split into four files because one file would be too large; words[] here stays empty. Private study use only.
